planets.name: TOI-1278 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1278 with a 14.5-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1278 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1278. Its orbit and size follow Artigau et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
